finding: drat-trim prints "detected and deleted duplicate literal ... of proof line N" for formula clauses (N = CNF clause index) in every PA19 pilot CNF of runs 003-005

resolution: A repeated literal does not change a clause (disjunction idempotence); drat-trim and kissat parse the same logical formula. No soundness effect; encoder semantics unchanged (the encoder review scope is unaffected).
